title: Genesis 22:15-16 letter grid: "sha" (שה, lamb) found at the lower right
summary: The Genesis 22:15-16 letter grid with a new gold box, tilted, around the letters ה and ש near the lower right of the grid. The gold labels "sha", שה and "Lamb" move down the right side to match. Gold-coloured letters mark the earlier pairs, and the ש in the green box is now gold too.

pictures.description: Grid of Hebrew letters (the text of Genesis 22:15-16 in rows) with purple מלאך, coloured letters of יהוה, a blue diagonal box, a tall red box around a column, a green row box, many gold-coloured letters, and a tilted gold box around two letters at the lower right.

uncertain: Dense letter grid not copied cell by cell; only the highlighted letters and labels are transcribed.
